title: Share turn-grant scalar parsing between exact grant reads and inspection details
outcome: Share turn-grant scalar parsing between exact grant reads and inspection details
acceptance: Both grant readers use shared state, millisecond timestamp and state/time coherence helpers while preserving exact-read refusal and diagnostic unknown/invalid behavior.
Focused regressions cover every stored grant state and malformed timestamp/coherence cases for both readers.
disposal_reason: The targeted active grant readers were removed with turn gating (landed at 5e8, cutover 6/6). Only refusal tests and doctor's historical-receipt reading still mention turn_begin, and both stay. Found by the legacy-scan explorer session-15943.
